subject: Citrine Logistics — PO finalization, spend-cap split and SKU deltas
messages:
From: Megan Hart <megan.hart@citrine-logistics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO requirements and line item reconciliation

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — Citrine is ready to proceed with Redwood for the freight-optimization pilot. Before we spin up procurement, I need two things from your side to confirm our internal PO flow:

1) A formal PO number to reference in our AP system (we typically capture this on our PO header and in Ariba).
2) A breakdown of spend caps by legal entity / BU (we're splitting the pilot across US West Ops and Central Ops).
3) Confirmation of SKU/line item mapping — our material codes (MC-*) don't match the descriptions in the initial invoice draft.

I've attached our W-9 and a spreadsheet with the line items we expect to see (citrine_line_items_v2.csv). Can you advise the typical turnaround for an issued provisional PO and whether Redwood can support split spend caps on a single PO?

Also include any onboarding forms you need filled out — I can loop our procurement lead into the thread once we have the PO pattern.

Thanks,
Megan Hart
Procurement Manager | Citrine Logistics
megan.hart@citrine-logistics.com
Attachment: Citrine_W9.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: citrine_line_items_v2.csv (text/csv)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Megan Hart <megan.hart@citrine-logistics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO requirements and line item reconciliation

Megan —

Appreciate the attachments and the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can issue a provisional PO and support a spend split; typical turnaround is 24–48 business hours once procurement confirms spend bands and BU routing. Action items below so we have a clear trail: 

- Connor: can you confirm whether procurement needs a separate PO per legal entity or if we should issue one PO with two spend buckets?
- Ben: can you provision a provisional PO (internal draft) and share any comments on tax/receipt strings for Ariba routing?
- Megan: can you confirm the exact legal entity names for the spend split (US West Ops / Central Ops) and whether Citrine requires separate invoice routing to ap-west@citrine-logistics.com and ap-central@citrine-logistics.com?

Regarding the SKU mismatch: I reviewed citrine_line_items_v2.csv and a few MC-* codes are mapped to non-standard descriptions. If you can provide a short mapping file (your MC code -> Redwood SKU), we can reconcile on our side and emit a corrected invoice template.

I'll leave the PO number issuance to Ben once Connor confirms the preferred routing.

Best,
Logan Wright
Program Manager, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Megan Hart <megan.hart@citrine-logistics.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO requirements and line item reconciliation

Logan / Connor / Megan —

Quick status from finance/sales-ops: we can allocate a provisional PO now to unblock Citrine while procurement finalizes the spend-cap policy. I've created provisional_PO_3421.pdf (attached) with the following constraints and notes:

- Provisional PO: PO-3421-PROV (not to be used for final accounting; placeholder for AP routing)
- Spend cap: total pilot not to exceed $95,000 USD. We can split the cap across two buckets: $55,000 (US West Ops) / $40,000 (Central Ops).
- Line items in the provisional PO are intentionally generic ("Pilot compute & inference") pending final SKU map. Please do not submit a final invoice against the provisional PO.

Connor: we need procurement to advise whether we should (A) issue a single PO with line-level spend buckets (preferred for Redwood to keep a single contract reference) or (B) issue two separate POs (one per BU) to match Citrine's AP ledger. Megan, if Citrine requires separate ERP POs for AP posting, please confirm ASAP so we can issue PO-3421 and PO-3422 within the same change window.

Megan, next steps for you:
- Confirm legal entity exact strings for routing and invoice headers.
- Share the MC->Redwood SKU mapping file (CSV) so we can align the line items.
- If you'd like, Connor and I can join a 30-min call to walk procurement through the PO flow and how provisional PO handoff -> final PO works in our system.

Attachment: provisional_PO_3421.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Ben / Logan / Connor —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for issuing PO-3421-PROV. We'll treat it as provisional per your note. Confirming the legal entity strings for the split: 

- Citrine Logistics US West, LLC (invoice to: ap-west@citrine-logistics.com) — $55,000
- Citrine Logistics Central, Inc. (invoice to: ap-central@citrine-logistics.com) — $40,000

- We will submit final invoices to the appropriate AP mailbox and reference PO-3421-PROV until you issue the final PO number.
